==Usage instructions==
Copy the template code below, and paste it into an article's reference note or Sources section. Fill in as many parameters as you can, remove any that you don't use.

<pre><nowiki>{{Databank|entry=|title=|url=|oldversion=|archivedate=|archiveurl=|archivefile=|nobackup=|quote=}}</nowiki></pre>

Care must be taken to avoid an incorrect link.

===Required parameters===
*{{Para|entry}} The URL of the page, minus <code><nowiki>https://www.starwars.com/databank/</nowiki></code>.
*{{Para|title}} The formatted text to display.
*For '''archive''' options, see [[#Backup links|Backup links]] below. Note: the default values for dates are centralized at [[Module:ArchiveAccess/Databank]]. This template will use the default value when omitting <code>archivedate</code> or <code>archiveurl</code>, but either can be provided to override the default value.

===Optional parameters===
*{{Para|url}} the /databank/ part of the URL can be overridden using use <code>|url=</code>, in cases where a Databank feature such as a biography or history gallery is located on the main domain.
*{{Para|oldversion}} use <code>|oldversion=1</code> when the current version of the Databank entry no longer includes the target information.
*{{Para|quote}} For including a quotation from the entry.

===Backup links===
{{BackupLinkHelp}}

==Example(s)==
<code><nowiki>{{Databank|admiral-piett|Admiral Piett}}</nowiki></code>

Results in:

{{Databank|admiral-piett|Admiral Piett}}

<hr />
;Using {{Para|archivedate}} to override the archive repository

<code><nowiki>{{Databank|admiral-piett|Admiral Piett|archivedate=20140807000324}}</nowiki></code>

Results in:

{{Databank|admiral-piett|Admiral Piett|archivedate=20140807000324}}
<hr />

;Using {{Para|url}}

<code><nowiki>{{Databank|url=aayla-secura-biography-gallery|title=Aayla Secura Biography Gallery|archivedate=20190910060509}}</nowiki></code>

Results in:

{{Databank|url=aayla-secura-biography-gallery|title=Aayla Secura Biography Gallery|archivedate=20190910060509}}
